notes: Seed page returns 404; www.co.bowie.tx.us redirects to www.bowiecounty.org (CivicPlus). The server stamps every DocumentCenter file with the request time as Last-Modified (Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:33-15:34 GMT), so it gives no upload evidence; only printed run times are used. No Clarity site (elections.json 404); the Elections page also links 'Texas Election Results' (SOS goelect site). 2024 general and 2026 primary: the posted unofficial file is an Electionware county Summary printed the next morning, and precinct numbers appear only in 'Official' Pct X Pct reports. 2026 runoff: an unofficial 'Precinct Summary' (per precinct, with Election Day column) printed 10:33 PM election night is posted; treated as END on printed run time only. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-3): 2024_general LATER to UNDETERMINED; 2026_primary LATER to UNDETERMINED. Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): none.
tag_rationale: After Rule 43: 2024_general UNDETERMINED, 2026_primary UNDETERMINED, 2026_runoff END. Exactly one election is determined, so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT with low confidence. Rule 47 checked 2026-10-02: no change.
